decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, 1007/01, 1007/02, 1007/03, 1007/04, and Flood Risk Matrix and Typical Detail showing Damp Proofing, received: 22/05/2018. 1007/06 A, 1007/07 A, 1007/08 A, 1007/09 A, 1007/11 A, and 1007/12 received: 10/07/2018. 1007/05 C and 1007/10 C received: 23/07/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Prior to commencement of the development hereby approved, a Method Statement relating to the refurbishment of the side porch shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The statement shall be accompanied by 1:20 scaled drawings, and specification of proposed materials including brickwork and pointing. The refurbishment shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Restoration of porch arch with installation of flat roof and roof window, alterations to the roof and change of fenestration on the rear extension, alterations to front garden and existing basement light well, and erection of bin and cycle storage to the house.
